# Kitty's Law [theUltimator5]

- url: https://www.tradingview.com/script/EhbdwurQ-Kitty-s-Law-theUltimator5/
- type: indicator
- pine_id: PUB;d734af3d7f994b318d628f9ec5f158a1
- version: 4.0

## Description

MOASS is tomorrow.
MOASS will always be tomorrow.

Murphy's law states anything that can go wrong will go wrong.
With GameStop, we have something called [b]Kitty’s law[/b].
[b]Kitty’s law[/b] states that whenever people can fit in a March-May 2024 fractal, people will fit in a March-May 2024 fractal.

[b]This indicator is an embodiment of Kitty's law.[/b]

This indicator matches the current price action to the GME fractal from 2024, finds a best fit section, then projects forwards the resulting price action.  A short squeeze has never been so near!

[b]HOW IT WORKS[/b]
Now getting into the technical aspects of this indicator, since it is a bit more complicated than the silly description has it seem.

The values from 2024 are hard coded into arrays.  There are two arrays.  Hourly and daily.  If the timeframe is set to daily, it will use the daily array for comparison.  If any other timeframe, it will use hourly (yes I know that weekly, monthly etc... are correlating to hourly but deal with it)

The indicator then uses a lookback period off the current bar (you can define the length) and finds the best fit section match from the selected array (hourly or daily) using a custom Pearson correlation algorithm.  Once it finds the best fit section match, it plots it over the chart and projects the rest of the array onto the chart, filling out the fractal.

If the ticker you are looking at is NOT GME, then it won't project anything.  Instead, it will tell you to stop looking at bad tickers and go back to GME.

[i]Disclaimer:  This indicator is meant for fun and is NOT a technical analysis indicator and is cosmetic only![/i]

## Source Code

````pine
// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © TheUltimator5

//@version=6
indicator("Kitty's Law [theUltimator5]", overlay=true, max_bars_back=5000, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=500)


// USER INPUTS
plotStyle           = input.string("Candles", title="Plot Style", options=["Candles","Lines"])
autoSweep           = input.bool(false, title="Auto-Sweep Best Length (40-100)")
sweepMin            = input.int(40, title="Sweep Min Length", minval=5, maxval=200)
sweepMax            = input.int(100, title="Sweep Max Length", minval=5, maxval=200)
correlationLength   = input.int(30, title="Correlation Length (Manual)", minval=5)
matchedLineColor    = input.color(color.rgb(255, 0, 255), title="Match Color")
projectionLineColor = input.color(color.rgb(0, 255, 180), title="Projection Color")

// ─── CORRELATION ENGINE ─────────────────────────────────────
var float   bestCorr   = na
var int     bestOffset = na
var float[] mSeg  = array.new_float(0)
var float[] mO    = array.new_float(0)
var float[] mH    = array.new_float(0)
var float[] mL    = array.new_float(0)
var float[] mCl   = array.new_float(0)
var float[] pSeg  = array.new_float(0)
var float[] pO    = array.new_float(0)
var float[] pH    = array.new_float(0)
var float[] pL    = array.new_float(0)
var float[] pCl   = array.new_float(0)
var line[]  drawnLines = array.new_line()
var box[]   drawnBoxes = array.new_box()

calcCorr(a, b, n) =>
    float sA = 0.0
    float sB = 0.0
    for i = 0 to n - 1
        sA += array.get(a, i)
        sB += array.get(b, i)
    float mA = sA / n
    float mB = sB / n
    float num = 0.0
    float dA  = 0.0
    float dB  = 0.0
    for i = 0 to n - 1
        float da = array.get(a, i) - mA
        float db = array.get(b, i) - mB
        num += da * db
        dA  += da * da
        dB  += db * db
    num / math.sqrt(dA * dB)

if barstate.islast and syminfo.ticker == "GME"
    dsz = array.size(dC)

    int   usedLength = correlationLength
    int   usedOffset = na
    float usedCorr   = na

    int extMin  = hasExtended and not isDaily ? 50 : 0
    int sweepLo = autoSweep ? math.max(math.min(sweepMin, sweepMax), extMin) : math.max(correlationLength, extMin)
    int sweepHi = autoSweep ? math.max(sweepMin, sweepMax)                   : math.max(correlationLength, extMin)
    int numLens = sweepHi - sweepLo + 1

    for li = 0 to numLens - 1
        int testLen  = sweepLo + li
        int maxStart = dsz - testLen - 1
        if maxStart < 0
            maxStart := -1

        float[] rp = array.new_float(testLen, 0.0)
        for rj = 0 to testLen - 1
            array.set(rp, rj, close[rj])

        if maxStart >= 0
            for si = 0 to maxStart
                float[] hp = array.new_float(testLen, 0.0)
                for hj = 0 to testLen - 1
                    array.set(hp, hj, array.get(dC, si + hj))
                float c = calcCorr(hp, rp, testLen)
                if not na(c) and (na(usedCorr) or c > usedCorr)
                    usedCorr   := c
                    usedOffset := si
                    usedLength := testLen

    bestCorr   := usedCorr
    bestOffset := usedOffset

    recentPrices = array.new_float(usedLength, 0.0)
    for j = 0 to usedLength - 1
        array.set(recentPrices, j, close[j])

    if not na(bestOffset)
        actualProjLen = dsz - bestOffset - usedLength

        array.clear(mSeg)
        array.clear(mO)
        array.clear(mH)
        array.clear(mL)
        array.clear(mCl)
        array.clear(pSeg)
        array.clear(pO)
        array.clear(pH)
        array.clear(pL)
        array.clear(pCl)
        for j = 0 to usedLength - 1
            k = bestOffset + j
            array.push(mSeg, array.get(dC, k))
            array.push(mO,   array.get(dO, k))
            array.push(mH,   array.get(dH, k))
            array.push(mL,   array.get(dL, k))
            array.push(mCl,  array.get(dC, k))
        for j = 0 to actualProjLen - 1
            k = bestOffset + usedLength + j
            array.push(pSeg, array.get(dC, k))
            array.push(pO,   array.get(dO, k))
            array.push(pH,   array.get(dH, k))
            array.push(pL,   array.get(dL, k))
            array.push(pCl,  array.get(dC, k))

    if array.size(drawnLines) > 0
        for k = 0 to array.size(drawnLines) - 1
            line.delete(array.get(drawnLines, k))
        array.clear(drawnLines)
    if array.size(drawnBoxes) > 0
        for k = 0 to array.size(drawnBoxes) - 1
            box.delete(array.get(drawnBoxes, k))
        array.clear(drawnBoxes)

    if array.size(mSeg) == usedLength and array.size(pSeg) > 0
        actualProjSize = array.size(pSeg)
        hBase = array.get(mSeg, 0)
        cBase = close[0]

        hHigh  = array.max(mSeg)
        hLow   = array.min(mSeg)
        hRange = hHigh - hLow

        rHigh  = array.max(recentPrices)
        rLow   = array.min(recentPrices)
        rRange = rHigh - rLow

        rScale = hRange != 0.0 ? rRange / hRange : 1.0

        if plotStyle == "Lines"
            for j = 0 to usedLength - 2
                t1 = cBase + (array.get(mSeg, j)     - hBase) * rScale
                t2 = cBase + (array.get(mSeg, j + 1) - hBase) * rScale
                array.push(drawnLines, line.new(bar_index - j, t1, bar_index - j - 1, t2, color=matchedLineColor, width=2))
        else
            for j = 0 to usedLength - 1
                tO = cBase + (array.get(mO,  j) - hBase) * rScale
                tH = cBase + (array.get(mH,  j) - hBase) * rScale
                tL = cBase + (array.get(mL,  j) - hBase) * rScale
                tC = cBase + (array.get(mCl, j) - hBase) * rScale
                bp  = bar_index - j
                array.push(drawnLines, line.new(bp, tH, bp, tL, color=matchedLineColor, width=1))
                array.push(drawnBoxes, box.new(bp, math.max(tO,tC), bp, math.min(tO,tC), border_color=matchedLineColor, bgcolor=tC>=tO ? color.new(matchedLineColor,80) : matchedLineColor, border_width=1))

        if plotStyle == "Lines"
            for j = 0 to actualProjSize - 2
                t1 = cBase + (array.get(pSeg, j)     - hBase) * rScale
                t2 = cBase + (array.get(pSeg, j + 1) - hBase) * rScale
                array.push(drawnLines, line.new(bar_index + j + 1, t1, bar_index + j + 2, t2, color=projectionLineColor, style=line.style_dotted, width=2))
        else
            for j = 0 to actualProjSize - 1
                tO = cBase + (array.get(pO,  j) - hBase) * rScale
                tH = cBase + (array.get(pH,  j) - hBase) * rScale
                tL = cBase + (array.get(pL,  j) - hBase) * rScale
                tC = cBase + (array.get(pCl, j) - hBase) * rScale
                bp  = bar_index + j + 1
                array.push(drawnLines, line.new(bp, tH, bp, tL, color=projectionLineColor, width=1))
                array.push(drawnBoxes, box.new(bp, math.max(tO,tC), bp, math.min(tO,tC), border_color=projectionLineColor, bgcolor=tC>=tO ? color.new(projectionLineColor,80) : projectionLineColor, border_width=1))

var table warningTable = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 1, border_width=2)
if syminfo.ticker != "GME"
    table.cell(warningTable, 0, 0,
         "THIS ISN'T GME.\nYOU WON'T FIND MOASS HERE.\nGO BACK TO GME",
         text_color=color.rgb(255, 0, 255),
         bgcolor=color.rgb(0, 0, 0),
         text_size=size.normal)
````
